description: Use when you need altcoin discovery, new token listings or fresh Base tokens with real liquidity to research. Do not use for established coins, other chains or DEXs, price history, trading signals or token safety audits. Returns JSON with new tokens on Base that just got liquidity: Uniswap v3 pools created in the last hours against WETH or USDC, read on-chain from pool creation events, with price, depth and age for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 3000 ms (p95). Category: Trading. Price: US$0.005 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

hours.description: Look back this many hours for new pools, 1 to 72 (24 when omitted), e.g. 24

limit.description: Tokens to return, 1 to 25 (10 when omitted), e.g. 5

minDepthUsd.description: Minimum USD on the WETH or USDC side of the pool (5000 when omitted), e.g. 10000

quote.description: Quote side of the pool (any when omitted), e.g. "WETH"

name: blackwood_altcoin_discovery
title: Altcoin discovery on Base
